# اِبْتَلَعْتِ (ibtalaʕti) /ib.ta.laʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# اِبْتَلَعَتْ (ibtalaʕat) /ib.ta.la.ʕat/: third-perso
